reviewScope: Emitted behavioral regions of the two account artifacts the runtime payload stages. Re-reviewed block by block against the compiled 0.2.1-alpha.3 bytes and diffed against the compiled 0.2.1-alpha.2 bytes; no pin was refreshed without reading the changed body.

alpha3Delta: Upstream removed the request/response/response-codes/envelope-rejected `console.info` reports and now reports failures through `console.error("[deepseek-account] request failed", ...)` gated by a new `callerCancelled(signal)` helper, with errorCode `expired` (401 branch), `network` (!ok / null body) and `no-response` (fetch rejection).
Envelope issues moved into the `response rejected` error log via hoisted `codes` / `validationError`.
blockReview.portMutation: The verification-required guard (`accountResponseMetadata(response)` plus the unchanged condition `metadata.verification !== null && !(401 && x-dsh-auth-token)`, body cancel, `PlatformAuthError("network")`, `accountReason = "verification-required"`) is INSERTED BEFORE the alpha.3 401 branch. The alpha.3 body deliberately keeps NO per-response info log, and this port does not restore one. The alpha.2/rc.2 entries keep their reviewed enriched response log.

alpha3Delta: Exactly one line: the "sign-in failed" report moved from `console.info` to `console.error`.
blockReview.portMutation: Unchanged. The CallbackOrigin pair `const origin = loginOrigin(callbackOrigin);` is byte-identical and still occurs exactly once, so the caller-validated origin is preserved and only the native Host callback origin is substituted (`desktopCallbackOrigin`, DSH_PORT_DESKTOP_CALLBACK).
Cached-profile presentation and background refresh are unchanged; the legacy portable disk fallback stays accepted for 0.1.7-rc.2 only.
